patch-mcp.note: Hosted Patch MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE). On first connection the agent opens www.patchmcp.com in the browser: the user enters the phone number calls should come from and confirms the code texted to it. No API key to paste. Tools: place_call, get_call, list_calls, end_call. Only endpoint contacted: https://www.patchmcp.com. Terms: https://www.patchmcp.com/terms
